core.reason: Every agent works better when it can navigate the codebase as a graph instead of grepping blindly.
Forces a design conversation before code, the cheapest place to catch wrong assumptions.
Turns designs into small verified steps, which keeps long agent sessions on track.
Tests written first are the agent's main defence against confident but wrong code.
Root-cause debugging stops the patch-on-patch spiral that burns tokens.
Evidence before 'done' removes the most common agent failure: claiming success without checking.
A security pass on every diff catches what functional tests never look for.
Agents hallucinate package names; attackers register them. The guard blocks that at install time.
